title: Captain warns Sherman he won't be allowed out

tellings.quote: >> um, I honestly don't think you're going to be able to get out.

plain: Some time between 1990 and 1993, at a place he calls Base 2, a captain warned a young sergeant that he would not be allowed to leave the work he had been given. The sergeant, Dan Sherman, tells it himself. He says the National Security Agency, the US agency that listens in on communications, hired him to talk with aliens, and he remembers the captain saying, "I honestly don't think you're going to be able to get out." If true, it suggests the programme did not let its people walk away.
